description: One row of the Vault admission ledger. An admission binds a product lot to the Hallmark report that passed it. A withdrawal is the same record type carrying action=withdraw: the Vault records that something is no longer held rather than deleting the row that said it was, so the ledger stays append-only and the earlier claim remains visible. Fields common to both stay shared; the conditional blocks below are the only place the two actions differ, which is where a future action would be grown.

reason.description: Why the product was withdrawn. Required on withdrawal and refused on admission: an admission that needs a reason is not an admission.

retracted_admission_receipt_hash.description: The admission_receipt_hash of the row being withdrawn, binding the withdrawal to the exact claim it retracts. Null when the earlier admission carried no receipt hash to bind.
